# Micro-SaaS Runway Price Floor Calculator

URL: https://micro-saas-runway-price-floor-calculator.vercel.app/
Source: https://github.com/Turner-Levey/micro-saas-runway-price-floor-calculator
Tiny Tool Town listing: https://www.tinytooltown.com/tools/micro-saas-runway-price-floor-calculator/
No-Login Tools listing: https://nologin.tools/tool/micro-saas-runway-price-floor-calculator-vercel-app/
No-Login Tools badge: https://nologin.tools/badge/micro-saas-runway-price-floor-calculator-vercel-app/
License: MIT
Maintainer: Turner Levey

## Summary

Free browser-only calculator for estimating a micro-SaaS monthly price floor, break-even customer count, gross-margin revenue gap, and runway pressure from current ARPA, active customers, monthly churn, expected new customers, gross margin, fixed overhead, founder income target, growth budget, and cash reserve.

## Use Cases

- Bootstrapped founders estimating a minimum sustainable monthly ARPA.
- Micro-SaaS operators comparing current price to overhead and income targets.
- Tiny SaaS builders deciding whether to test packaging, retention, annual plans, or customer acquisition before changing price.

## Privacy And Runtime

- No signup.
- No cookies.
- No analytics or trackers.
- No uploads.
- No external scripts.
- No runtime network calls.
- No browser storage.
- Markdown and CSV outputs are generated locally in the browser.

## Boundaries

This is a planning worksheet. It is not legal, financial, tax, accounting, pricing-strategy, or investment advice.
